test_results.question: What was total debit spending in June 2026?
test_results.interpretation: Debit Transactions Only; Filtered by Bank / Entity Schema; Gross Amounts.
test_results.sql: SELECT SUM(t.transaction_amount) AS metric_value FROM transaction t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN bank b ON a.bank_code = b.bank_code  WHERE t.transaction_type IN (?) AND t.transaction_date >= '2026-06-01' AND t.transaction_date <= '2026-06-30'

test_results.question: Which bank had the highest transaction spending in 2025?
test_results.interpretation: Debit Transactions Only; Filtered by Bank / Entity Schema; Gross Amounts.
test_results.sql: SELECT b.bank_name AS group_label, SUM(t.transaction_amount) AS metric_value FROM transaction t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN bank b ON a.bank_code = b.bank_code  WHERE t.transaction_type IN (?) AND t.transaction_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.transaction_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY b.bank_name ORDER BY metric_value DESC LIMIT 1
